turns.question: What was the median number of days from application to hire for candidates hired in September or October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median days-to-hire metric; its Time to hire (days) metric is an average of days from applying to being hired, and for candidates hired 1 September to 31 October 2026 it is 6.08 days. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
